job.title: EU Communications Officer @ COMPASSION IN WORLD FARMING (Brussels, BRU, BE)
job.description:
Job Advert

**Compassion in World Farming International****is a global movement transforming the future of food and farming. Help bring our mission to life in Brussels through communications that inspire action for farm animals.**

**EU Communications Officer**

**Role type:** Full time; Permanent

**Location:** EU Office, Brussels (hybrid flexible working available, with at least 2 days in the office per week)

**Salary:** €56,000 - €62,000 gross per annum (depending upon skills and experience), inclusive of 13th month salary and holiday pay

**About the role**

As our **EU Communications Officer**, you’ll use your words, ideas and relationship-building skills to help advance our mission to end factory farming. Based in Brussels and reporting to the Head of CIWF EU, you’ll bring our EU work to life through engaging content, media outreach and support for our global campaigns.

Working closely with our Brussels colleagues and HQ communications and campaigns teams, you’ll turn important food and farming issues into clear, compelling stories.

This is a varied, hands-on role, where you’ll be responsible for:

* **Communications and content -** Writing press releases, web news and social media posts, managing EU website content and social channels and creating visual materials that engage audiences and support our campaigns.
* **Media and stakeholder engagement -** Building relationships with Brussels-based journalists and stakeholders, raising the profile of our EU work and keeping our media contacts database up to date.
* **Coordination and events -** Helping organise in-person and virtual events, and support effective collaboration between our EU office, HQ and colleagues in Member States.
* **Administration and office support -** Taking ownership of practical administrative, operational and office management tasks, using our systems and supporting specific projects as needed.

**About you**

To succeed as our **EU Communications Officer**, you’ll need strong experience of political communications in Brussels that supports change with governments or intergovernmental institutions, ideally alongside experience in the non-profit sector. You’ll enjoy adapting your message to different audiences, and have a genuine interest in farm animal welfare, food and environmental issues.

You’ll need to be a thoughtful, collaborative colleague who treats people with dignity and respect, works sensitively across cultures and takes pride in high ethical standards. Comfortable working independently as well as with others, you’ll balance communications projects with practical office tasks and follow through on your commitments.

Skills and experience you’ll need to bring as our EU Communications Officer:

  

* Fluent English, excellent written and verbal communication skills, a strong news sense, and experience creating effective communications materials for a range of audiences, particularly for the Brussels bubble.
* Strong organisational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to prioritise your workload, use your initiative and take responsibility for projects and operational tasks.
* Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and internet tools, plus experience with, or a willingness to learn, Canva, InDesign, Photoshop and Adobe Premiere Pro.

Previous experience with Brussels media or institutions, journalist contacts, campaigning knowledge and insight into EU political processes is essential. Event or webinar coordination, working in international teams, and additional European languages would be welcome.

*If you don’t meet every requirement but believe you could thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply.*

**Why join us**

***This is an opportunity to put your communications skills to work for a cause that matters, helping build a more compassionate future for farmed animals through our work in Brussels.***

You’ll get to collaborate with colleagues across our international organisation and contribute to campaigns connecting animal welfare with the future of food and farming.

**How to apply and key dates**

If you’re ready to make a global impact, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your **CV and a cover letter** (in English) outlining how you meet the Person Specification. To support a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly ask that you do not include a photo in your CV. Please note that we may begin interviews on a rolling basis, so early applications are encouraged.

**Closing date:** Thursday 19 November 2026

**1st Stage (Teams) Interview, with task:** Anticipated on either Monday 23 or Thursday 26 November 2026

**2nd Stage (Teams) Interview:** Anticipated Wednesday 9 December 2026

***OPTIONAL:*** **3rd Stage (In-Person) Interview** at the Brussels office

*“**Join us in building a more compassionate future for animals, people, and the planet.”*

As part of Stage 1 interviews, shortlisted candidates may receive pre‑shared, values‑based interview questions to support a positive candidate experience. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know, we’re always happy to support candidates.

**About Compassion**

Compassion in World Farming International is a leading global organisation working to end factory farming. Founded in 1967 by British farmer Peter Roberts, we’ve spent over 50 years driving change, successfully campaigning to ban cruel practices such as barren battery cages, veal crates, and sow stalls across the UK and Europe.

Our work combines advocacy, campaigning, and collaboration with policymakers and businesses to promote animal welfare and sustainable food systems. We envision a future where animals are treated with compassion, and farming supports both people and the planet. To learn more about our mission, culture, and opportunities, please explore our **Candidate Pack****, and** **Careers Page****.**

To comply with legal requirements internationally, all applicants must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the country where the role is based.

*Compassion in World Farming is absolutely committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone regardless of their background. We value diversity and live experience and acknowledge the underrepresentation of people from certain backgrounds, both within our organisation and across the sector. We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, whether these be of ethnicity, gender, identity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation or other.*

job.title: Short-Form Content Creator @ CoinPoker (Remote)
job.description:
**Title**
: Short-Form Content Creator
  
  
**Department**
: Content
  
  
**Location**
: Remote
  
  
**About CoinPoker**
Welcome to CoinPoker, the innovative crypto-poker platform where advanced blockchain technology meets the thrilling world of online poker. At CoinPoker, we are revolutionizing the poker experience by offering fast, secure, and transparent gameplay. With recent substantial investment, we are poised to take over the online crypto-poker space and are expanding our team to support our growth.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Short-Form Content Creator is responsible for producing short-form content for CoinPoker's channels end to end, from finding the strongest moments in raw footage through to the final platform-ready edit across Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
  
  
The role is focused on scouring streams, tournaments, and partner footage for the hands, reactions, and moments that carry genuine drama, tension, or humour, cutting them into content structured to stop the scroll and hold attention through to the payoff, and maintaining consistent quality at the volume and cadence short-form demands.
  
  
The role requires a genuine feel for what makes short-form perform, including hooks, pacing, payoff placement, sound, and captions, and the poker literacy to recognise which moments are worth building content around in the first place.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Create short-form content end to end for CoinPoker's channels, from finding the moment in raw footage through selection, cut, hook construction, captions, sound, and platform-native formatting, delivering finished content ready for publishing.
* Scour streams, tournament footage, and ambassador and partner content on an ongoing basis, identifying the hands, reactions, and moments that carry genuine drama, tension, or humour, and building a bank of usable material for current and future formats.
* Work to structural briefs on hooks, pacing, and payoff placement, applying feedback from the weekly performance review to each next edit and contributing ideas where a stronger structural approach exists.
* Produce content across CoinPoker's repeatable formats and series, maintaining the consistency that makes formats recognisable while keeping individual edits fresh.
* Support campaign and promotional content requirements, including tournament series, product launches, and partner collaboration clips, working to campaign briefs and deadlines alongside ongoing channel output.
* Maintain consistent output quality at the volume and cadence short-form requires, managing your own edit pipeline and delivering reliably against the content calendar.
* Use AI and modern editing tools wherever they make output faster or better, without letting the craft slip.

**Highly Desired Knowledge and Experience:**

* A portfolio of short-form content you produced that went viral or drove significant reach, ideally in iGaming, poker, or an adjacent space, with the numbers to prove it and the ability to explain what made it work.
* A real understanding of poker and what makes a moment compelling to a poker audience, including the ability to watch a session and know instinctively which hands, coolers, bluffs, and reactions will land, not just which are technically interesting.
* Demonstrated ability to source content from raw footage independently, reviewing hours of streams or tournament footage and judging what is worth cutting without being told where to look.
* Genuine feel for what stops the scroll, including hooks, pacing, payoff placement, sound, and captions, and how each platform's format and audience reward them differently.
* Demonstrated ability to produce at speed and volume without quality collapsing, including managing your own pipeline against a content calendar.
* Fluency with modern editing tools and AI tooling where it genuinely improves speed or quality.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in the blockchain and online gaming industry.
* Flexible working hours and the ability to work fully remotely.
* A collaborative and inclusive team culture.
* Professional development opportunities and career growth within a rapidly evolving company.

job.title: Growth Engineer (Fullstack, Frontend-Focused) @ Pennylane SAS (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

**Our vision**
==============

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

**About us**
============

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

**Your impact**
===============

**Great growth experiences are built by great engineers.**
----------------------------------------------------------

At Pennylane, Growth Engineering is about more than building landing pages or running experiments. It's about creating fast, reliable and seamless digital experiences that help entrepreneurs discover Pennylane and get started.

As we expand across Europe, our website and acquisition journeys need to become more scalable, more flexible and more effective.

We're looking for a **Growth Engineer with strong frontend expertise** to help us build the next generation of Pennylane's digital experiences.

You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with **Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead**, within the Marketing Website squad.

Your work will have a direct impact on how users discover, experience and adopt Pennylane.

**What you'll do**
==================

**Build great web experiences**
-------------------------------

You'll develop and improve our public website and acquisition journeys, with a strong focus on frontend engineering.

* Build modern, responsive and high-performing interfaces using Vue.js and Nuxt.js.
* Develop and maintain fullstack features using Ruby on Rails.
* Improve website performance, accessibility and user experience.
* Build reusable components and scalable frontend solutions.

**Drive growth through engineering**
------------------------------------

You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to turn business opportunities into technical solutions.

* Build and improve acquisition and registration funnels.
* Design and implement A/B tests and new user experiences.
* Improve conversion through technical experimentation.
* Develop features that support our international expansion, including localization and multilingual experiences.

**Connect systems and data**
----------------------------

You'll contribute to the technical foundations that power our growth initiatives.

* Build and maintain APIs and integrations between internal and external tools.
* Ensure reliable data flows across our digital ecosystem.
* Contribute to tracking implementations and data quality improvements.
* Work with Data teams to better understand user journeys and experiment results.

**Improve how we build**
------------------------

You'll help us move fast without compromising engineering quality.

* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate workflows.
* Use AI-powered development tools when they bring real value.
* Take ownership of your projects, from technical design to production.
* Share knowledge and contribute to engineering best practices.

**Who are you?**
================

**We're looking for an engineer who enjoys building products, solving technical challenges and seeing the impact of their work.**

Someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with curiosity about user experience, experimentation and business impact.

You don't need to be a marketing expert. But you should enjoy understanding why you're building something, not just how to build it.

**We'd love to meet you if...**
===============================

* You have experience in software engineering, with strong frontend development skills.
* You're comfortable building modern web applications with **Vue.js and/or Nuxt.js**, or have strong experience with comparable frameworks and are ready to work with our stack.
* You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high.
* You have fullstack experience and can contribute to backend development. Experience with **Ruby on Rails** is a strong plus.
* You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects from idea to production.
* You're comfortable collaborating with Engineering, Product, Growth, Marketing and Data teams.
* You're curious about experimentation, conversion optimization and how users interact with digital products.
* You're comfortable working in French and English.

**Bonus points if you have experience with:**
---------------------------------------------

* Web analytics and tracking tools such as Segment, Amplitude or Google Tag Manager.
* A/B testing and experimentation platforms.
* SEO, web performance or conversion optimization.
* API integrations and marketing automation.
* AI-assisted development workflows.

**Our tech stack**
==================

* **Frontend:** Vue.js, Nuxt.js, JavaScript
* **Backend:** Ruby on Rails
* **Database:** PostgreSQL
* **Development:** Git, GitHub

You'll also have opportunities to work with analytics, tracking and experimentation tools depending on the projects.

**Why you'll love this role**
=============================

* **Real impact:** Your work will directly influence how new customers discover and adopt Pennylane.
* **Engineering challenges:** You'll build scalable solutions, not just implement marketing requests.
* **Ownership:** You'll have the freedom to propose ideas, make technical decisions and drive projects forward.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** You'll work at the intersection of Engineering, Growth, Marketing and Data.
* **Room to experiment:** You'll be encouraged to test ideas, learn from results and continuously improve what we build.

**If you love building great web experiences and want your engineering work to have a measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.**

**What do we do to make your work life easier**
===============================================

Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

You’ll have a competitive compensation package

You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

*We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.*

**Who are we looking for ?**
============================

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

* To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
* To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
* To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

job.title: Growth & Marketing Operations Manager @ Simaero (Tremblay-en-France, Île-de-France, France)
job.description:
As Growth & Marketing Operations Manager, you will own the performance of Simaero’s marketing funnel across B2B and B2C pilot training segments.

Your role is to turn marketing initiatives into measurable business impact by optimizing acquisition, conversion, and lead nurturing—leveraging data, experimentation, and close collaboration with Content, Product Marketing, Sales, and RevOps.

You report directly to the Marketing & Communications Director.

This is a job creation: you will play a key role in shaping a modern, performance-driven marketing function within a fast-growing international company.

**What you will own:**

* **Marketing Automation:**
  Define and optimize Simaero’s marketing automation infrastructure across all audiences, building automated workflows, lead scoring, and email sequences. Track KPIs, document learnings, and implement a continuous improvement roadmap across B2B and B2C funnels.

* **Campaign Management:**
  Plan and execute targeted multi-channel digital campaigns to support simulator ramp-up, events, and new product launches. Coordinate the team and agencies with clear directives to ensure consistent campaign execution across touchpoints, manage budget allocation across channels and report on ROI.

* **New Segment Development:**
  Build the go-to-market approach for a new offer addressing young pilots: segment definition, partnership outreach to flight schools, content and campaign strategy, and lead capture setup.

* **Community & Events Marketing:**
  Co-own the pilot community strategy with the content specialist. Lead the end-to-end marketing strategy for online and onsite pilot-facing events from promotion and registration flow to post-event nurturing sequences, with clear acquisition or retention objectives for each.

* **Performance review & Continuous Improvement:**
  Consolidate data from all campaigns, channels, and funnels into a clear monthly reporting view presented to the Marketing Director. Drive a test-and-learn culture across all initiatives, systematically documenting what works, killing what doesn't, and feeding findings back into the next campaign, automation, or event cycle.

* **Marketing & Sales Alignment:**
  Work closely with the Commercial team to align campaigns with pipeline priorities, improve lead qualification and handover processes, and ensure marketing actions translate into commercial opportunities.

**What you’ll find with us:**

* Real ownership from day one. As part of a small, high-output team, your work is directly visible and its impact felt across the whole company.
* A clear scope, always evolving. Your missions are defined, but the challenges are varied across segments, products, and markets. No two quarters look the same.
* Room to grow. Simaero is expanding its network and its ambitions. The person who builds the growth engine now will shape what comes next.
* A genuinely international environment. You will work with direct interactions across all business units and cultures.
* Flexible work schedule. We ask for a minimum of 2 days onsite at our Tremblay-en-France office. Beyond that, we trust you to be where the work needs you.

**Required Profile**

**Experience:**

* 3 to 5 years in marketing role with a clear digital and growth focus, ideally in a B2B or B2B2C industry with complex selling cycles.
* Aviation background is not required, but genuine interest in the industry is a plus.

**Hard skills:**

* Proven experience building and optimizing multi-channel workflows, campaigns, and event programs — not just contributing to them, but owning them end to end.
* Strong understanding of marketing funnels and conversion optimization with a data-driven approach.
* Knowledge of the main marketing tools: Google Analytics, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, email and landing page builders.
* Daily habit of working with CRM (Hubspot) and marketing automation tools. Familiarity with low-code/no-code automation tools (n8n, Make, or equivalent) is a strong plus.

**Soft skills:**

* Autonomous and structured: you manage multiple projects simultaneously without losing the thread and prioritize effectively.
* Test-and-learn approach: you experiment, measure, and iterate. You ask the why and how behind the data.
* Proactivity and business approach: you suggest new initiatives or new processes to support marketing performance, your actions directly serve the company business objectives
* Collaborative without being dependent: you know when to align and when to just decide and move.

**Language:**
English, French is a strong plus

**Salary range:**
38–45k€ as total salary package, depending on experience

**Start date:**
As soon as possible

**Process:**

* **Intro call**
  with our HR team to explore mutual fit with the role and the company culture
* **In-depth interview**
  with Marion, Marketing & Communications Director
* **Fit conversation**
  with Alexis, Commercial Director

  , on your request to do a reality-check behind the process

job.title: Growth Marketeer @ Lefebvre Sdu (Den Haag, ZH, NL)
job.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Growth Marketeer die een eigen marktsegment in handen neemt en laat groeien.

**HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT**

Een goede campagne bedenken is één ding. Weten wat een belastingadviseur, een bedrijfsjurist of een jurist bij de overheid in beweging krijgt, is iets anders. Ze werken allemaal met wet- en regelgeving, maar ze kopen anders, beslissen anders en vertrouwen op andere dingen. Een boodschap die bij een advocatenkantoor binnenkomt, zegt een legal team bij een multinational weinig. Daarom krijgt elk segment bij ons een eigen eigenaar, en jij wordt dat voor Legal/Tax, Corporate of Government. Daarvoor moet je je klanten echt willen begrijpen. Wie beslist er over een nieuwe oplossing, waar zit de twijfel en wat is er nodig om af te stappen van een werkwijze die al jaren goed genoeg is? Vanuit dat begrip bepaal je het verhaal, de kanalen en het budget, en elke keuze onderbouw je met cijfers. Een Campaign Manager en een bureau zetten jouw plannen in de praktijk om, zodat jij je kunt richten op de keuzes die het verschil maken. En je kijkt verder dan de eerste handtekening, want een klant die GenIA-L aanschaft maar er niet mee werkt, heeft er niets aan. Wat jij in de markt ziet, breng je terug naar sales, productontwikkeling en customer success. Zo wordt ons aanbod per segment scherper, en zie je wat jouw keuzes opleveren direct terug in de omzet.

**DIT ZOEKEN WIJ**

Je denkt groot en rekent scherp. Een sterke campagne bedenken geeft je energie, een stijgende conversie nog meer. Jij zet de lijnen uit, anderen voeren uit, en jij zorgt dat het resultaat er komt.

* 5 tot 7 jaar ervaring in B2B-marketing of growth.
* Je bouwt een business case die overtuigt en stuurt op funnelcijfers.
* Je hebt bureaus of collega's aangestuurd en het resultaat waargemaakt.
* Je schakelt moeiteloos van positionering naar de afstemming met sales en propositie.
* Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.
* Ken je de wereld van legal, tax, corporate of government al? Dan maak je sneller het verschil.

**HIER TEKEN JE VOOR**

Weinig marketeers krijgen de kans om een merk van ruim 200 jaar opnieuw in de markt te zetten. Jij wel. Lefebvre Sdu gaat van contentabonnementen naar software, en jij bepaalt hoe jouw segment die stap maakt. Je rapporteert aan de Head of Marketing, beheert een eigen budget en hebt de vrijheid om je eigen koers te varen.

* Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur.
* Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris.
* 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen.
* Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.
* Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling.
* Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag.
* Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie.

**MEER WETEN?**

Laat StudyGo internationaal groeien!

Elk jaar gebruiken ruim 650.000 middelbare scholieren StudyGo in Nederland om te leren voor toetsen en examens. Recent zijn we begonnen met de uitbreiding van StudyGo naar België en Polen. De uitdaging? Zorgen dat meer gebruikers buiten Nederland ontdekken hoe waardevol StudyGo is, zich gratis registreren of een betaalde trial starten én ook na die eerste weken blijven terugkomen.

We zoeken een Growth Marketeer die begrijpt hoe je een product laat groeien in een nieuwe markt en gebruikersgedrag vertaalt naar experimenten. Iemand die continu op zoek gaat naar manieren om de customer journey beter en slimmer te maken. Van advertenties en webpagina’s, tot registraties, betalingen en activatie in het product.

Je werkt op het snijvlak van marketing, product, data en design. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat steeds meer scholieren succesvol leren met StudyGo.

**🏰 Over Futurewhiz, Squla en StudyGo**

Al meer dan 15 jaar is Futurewhiz dé marktleider in EdTech in Nederland. Met merken als Squla en StudyGo helpen we kinderen en tieners van 3 tot 18 jaar om te leren en groeien op een manier die bij hen past.

Met Squla helpen we dagelijks meer dan een half miljoen basisschoolleerlingen leren door middel van games, quizzen en interactieve oefeningen die aansluiten op het Nederlandse onderwijs.

StudyGo (voorheen WRTS) is het grootste online leerplatform voor middelbare scholieren in Nederland. Van woordjes leren en oefentoetsen, tot groepslessen en persoonlijke begeleiding: StudyGo helpt scholieren slimmer te leren en met meer vertrouwen hun schooltijd door te komen. Voor deze rol werk je specifiek aan StudyGo internationaal, eerst met focus op België en Polen.

**🎮 Wat ga je doen?**

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor één van de belangrijkste groeivraagstukken van StudyGo Internationaal: hoe zorgen we voor meer naamsbekendheid onder leerlingen, ouders en leerkrachten, meer registraties en betalende gebruikers?

Dat betekent dat je continu op zoek bent naar nieuwe kansen in de marketing funnel. Je bent niet bang om te proberen (o.a. met AI), leert snel, analyseert graag, ontdekt waar gebruikers op aan gaan en vertaalt inzichten naar experimenten.

Je houdt je bijvoorbeeld bezig met vragen als:

* Waar liggen kansen in de Belgische en Poolse markt om meer registraties te genereren?
* Wat leren we van de cijfers uit Meta en Google en hoe kunnen we daar optimaliseren?
* Hoe kunnen we er voor zorgen dat meer leerlingen een betaalde trial starten?
* Welke onboarding helpt gebruikers sneller hun eerste succeservaring te bereiken?
* Welke A/B-test zorgt voor meer activatie of een hogere trial-conversie?
* Hoe voorkomen we dat nieuwe klanten in de eerste weken afhaken?
* Welke combinatie van productverbeteringen en marketing levert de meeste groei op?

Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met Product, Design, Engineering, Data en Customer Support. Sommige experimenten zitten in een landingspagina of e-mailflow, andere juist midden in het product. Ook spar je met de Nederlandse StudyGo marketeers, om ideeën uit te wisselen en deel je inzichten uit de internationale markt die ook waardevol voor Nederland kunnen zijn. Je gebruikt AI-tools actief in je dagelijkse werk en onderzoekt hoe AI nieuwe mogelijkheden de groei van StudyGo internationaal kunnen ondersteunen en versnellen.

Performancekanalen zoals Google Ads en Meta zijn onderdeel van je werk. Hierbij word je ondersteund door agencies. Kennis en hands-on ervaring met deze kanalen is een vereiste.

**🌟 Jouw verantwoordelijkheden**

* Verhogen van internationale registraties, activatie, trial-conversie en retentie.
* Je signaleert proactief kansen voor nieuwe kanalen en/of samenwerkingen.
* Opzetten, uitvoeren en analyseren van A/B-testen en experimenten.
* Optimaliseren van onboarding, user journeys en conversiemomenten.
* Analyseren van gebruikersgedrag en vertalen naar nieuwe groeihypotheses.

* Slim inzetten van AI-tools om sneller analyses uit te voeren en experimenten op te zetten.

Wij zoeken een marketingspecialist die zowel strategisch kan denken als praktisch kan handelen. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in de volgende eigenschappen:

* Je hebt minimaal 3+ jaar ervaring in growth marketing, performance marketing, CRO of een vergelijkbare rol.

job.title: Growth Marketing Manager (SaaS / Remote / EU) @ Publitas.com (Remote)
job.description:
**Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?**

**The Mission**

Publitas turns static, dead PDFs into interactive, shoppable digital content discovery experiences. Our Reach proposition — our consumer portals, including Folders.nl and Promobutler.be in the Benelux and Promozilla portals across ~40 countries — connects millions of shoppers with localized retail deals, flyers, and promotions. It is a core traffic and engagement engine for the company.

Your mission as Growth Marketing Manager is to own consumer traffic growth across our portals end to end. You will protect and grow our largest market (Benelux), where the bulk of today's traffic sits, while building a repeatable acquisition playbook to scale our newer Promozilla portals from a standing start. You own every lever that moves consumers to our portals — organic/SEO, social, affiliates and partnerships, paid, and lifecycle/retention. We work ~80% asynchronously and judge you on traffic growth, audience retention, and channel efficiency — not hours on Zoom.

**What Success Looks Like (Your First 90 Days)**

We measure outcomes, not tenure. In your first three months:

Day 30: You've achieved full campaign continuity with zero disruption to active Benelux flows, and audited traffic sources across the portal network — establishing a clear baseline of what drives volume in each live market and a working relationship with product and development.

Day 60: You've identified the highest-yield channel per market and the friction points capping growth (technical, behavioral, or distributional), and shipped your first round of experiments — across organic, paid, social, partnerships, or lifecycle — with early measurable lift.

Day 90: Your highest-leverage channels are running predictably in Benelux, and you've drafted and aligned a scalable acquisition playbook to roll out to the nascent Promozilla markets — mapped to the development team's product and UX/UI ETAs for Q3/Q4.

**The DNA of a Growth Marketer at Publitas**

**Founder-Level Ownership**
: You treat the portal network like your own business. You don't wait for a roadmap to be handed to you — you read the data, uncover the insight, chase down the tracking gap, and make high-impact calls autonomously.

**A Continuous Growth Mindset**
: Consumer behavior and search/distribution algorithms shift fast. You treat traffic as a system to be engineered — constantly testing unconventional loops, optimizing channel mix, and treating every performance drop as a data point to dissect and iterate on.

**High Autonomy, Low Ego**
: In a remote-first, async environment, the work speaks for itself. You're motivated by solving hard distribution problems, not by synchronous cheerleading, and you're comfortable being judged on the real health of portal traffic and retention.

**The Non-Negotiables**

**Multi-Channel Traffic Mastery**
: A proven track record driving consumer traffic at scale across the full mix — organic/SEO (including programmatic/technical SEO), paid social and search, affiliates and partnerships, and lifecycle/retention. You understand B2C shopper psychology and how audiences hunt for promotions.

**High-Volume B2C / Platform Background**
: Experience in app-first consumer marketplaces, coupon/deal platforms, news/media publishers, or large-scale e-commerce/affiliate networks.

**Programmatic & Multi-Market Scaling**
: You've scaled traffic across many markets or properties and understand how to standardize a playbook and localize it efficiently — rather than rebuilding from scratch per market.

**AI-First Execution**
: We do not scale headcount to solve manual problems. A demonstrable track record of using generative AI and automation to scale campaign copy and localization, build programmatic reporting loops, and trigger automated workflows. We are not looking for "AI-curious" — we look for people already using AI to do better work, with tangible impact to show.

**Flawless Professional English**
: You collaborate with the global Publitas team in English; your written communication must be exceptional for an async-first team.

**Dutch — strong plus**
.

**What We Offer You to Win**

* **Transparent Compensation:**
  A competitive entry-level base salary of
  **€40 000 - €60 000**
  (geo-bracketed to your location in the EU) with a clear, performance-based path for career progression.
* **True Remote Autonomy:**
  We work 80% asynchronously using Notion and Slack. We don't monitor your screen or count your hours—we trust you to own your delivery targets and manage your day.
* **Global Team Retreats:**
  Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.
* **Premium Workspace & Gear:**
  A top-tier MacBook, high-end remote work accessories, and co-working allowance if you prefer an office environment.
* **Personal Growth Budget:**
  A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your SaaS skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.
* **Time Off:**
  25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

*At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.*

*Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.*
